title: Foundation Week: Prioritization Notes & Exec Intake (v0.1)
summary: Working notes for Foundation Week framing: compressing the company-level asks, refining a small set of cross-functional priorities, and preparing a short exec intake for the all-hands. This is intentional lightweight, not the final playbook.
audience: Exec team, department leads, product & eng managers
objectives: 1) Surface 3 company-level priorities for Q3 launch cycle. 2) Capture exec asks and roll-call owners. 3) Produce a one-page all-hands slate and 10-minute run-of-show. 4) Flag operational risks and escalation paths.
background: We want one tight set of priorities that map to revenue, reliability, and developer velocity. Recent telemetry shows hosted API token growth but cost-per-token variance across model families; Dedicated RFP momentum with two mid-market pilots; Private pipeline gating on security docs. Foundation Week is the moment to align and keep the company lean for the next 12 weeks.
proposed_company_priorities:
Priority A — Predictable unit economics: reduce per-token cost variance by 25% through batching/quantization suggestions + cache profiling.
Priority B — Enterprise readiness: onboard 2 dedicated customers to Dedicated with SLA templates and KMS integration.
Priority C — Developer-first velocity: reduce time-to-prod for SDK-based integrations from signup-to-call from 2 days to same-day for common flows.
draft_okrs:
OKR 1 (Cost): Reduce median per-token cost for high-throughput customers by 25% (owner: infra/product).
KR1.1: Ship default batching profile for request patterns X and Y.
KR1.2: Add automatic prefix caching to hosted API for 3 top apps and measure savings.
OKR 2 (Enterprise): Convert two pilots into Dedicated contracts worth $X/month by EOY (owner: sales/solutions).
KR2.1: Finalize Dedicated onboarding checklist and SLA doc.
KR2.2: Complete KMS/HSM integration reference for Private customers.
OKR 3 (Velocity): Reduce friction for SDK onboarding (owner: devx).
KR3.1: Provide turnkey 'hello inference' template for top 3 languages with prebuilt examples.
KR3.2: Launch 'first-10-calls' telemetry and funnel to onboarding NPS.
exec_asks_and_decisions_needed:
- Approve prioritization of infra budget for quantization experiments (+$120k Q3).
- Executive sign-off on Dedicated pilot commercial terms (standardize negotiation floor).
- Decision on whether to short-circuit an immediate 'cost freeze' on experimental large models until profiling completes.
- Approval for a 30-day beta for 'auto-prefix caching' on hosted API (opt-out by customer).
allhands_run_of_show:
(10 min) CEO framing + one slide on market positioning and why priorities matter.
(12 min) Product highlight: 'Predictable inference in practice' demo (owner: product).
(8 min) Dedicated pilot announcement + customer success story (owner: sales/solutions).
(10 min) Operations: what we measure, what changes for teams (owner: SRE/infra).
(10 min) Q&A and how folks can plug in (floor -> team leads).
Post-hands: curated follow-up doc with tasks and owners delivered within 48 hours.
communication_guidelines: Keep the all-hands message tightly scoped: one page of priorities + one call to action per team. Execs should avoid deep product details; use signal: effect on customers and metrics. Share supporting docs in Confluence, not Slack threads, for the next 72 hours.
timeline_and_milestones:
Week 0 (Foundation Week): finalize priorities, exec intake, all-hands slate.
Week 1-2: Dept-level planning and OKR comms.
Week 3-6: Ship low-effort infra wins (batching defaults, telemetry).
Week 7-12: Pilot enablement for Dedicated + close two pilots.
End of quarter: measure impact, retro, decision on scaling investments.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: Profiling and quantization experiments take longer than expected -> Mitigation: run parallel small-n experiments and surface early negative results; earmark contingency budget.
Risk: Customer perception of 'auto-prefix caching' privacy -> Mitigation: opt-out flow + clear billing/telemetry notes.
Risk: Focus dilution across too many cross-functional asks -> Mitigation: require executive sign-off to add new company-level priority.
escalation_path:
Day-to-day: priority owners -> weekly company-ops sync.
Blocker (72h): raise to exec sponsor via #foundation-week channel + tagged slack call.
Major outage: SRE incident playbook (existing) + CEO brief within 2 hours.
open_questions:
- What is the exact budget uplift we can commit for quantization R&D?
- Do we need a separate compliance checkpoint for pilots using Private?
- Can sales commit the two target pilots this quarter or are they late-stage (need to confirm with AE leads)?
next_steps:
1) Triage exec asks — get budget owner and legal on quick call (owner: Aisha).
2) Product/Infra to draft scope for batching default and quantization pilot by EOW.
3) Sales to confirm pilot list and timeline — AE owners to email by Tue.
4) Draft all-hands one-pager and rehearse with execs (slot: Fri 1pm).
notes_to_self: Keep this doc short. We'll iterate into a proper playbook only after exec intake. Capture any off-script asks in the appendix (separate doc).
footnote: v0.1 — iterative, expect edits. If you add an item, append with initials + date.
